        L[i] = a[p + i];

int* sieve(int n) {
    int* a = new int[n + 1];
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) a[i] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(n); ++i) {
        if (a[i] == 1) {
            for (int k = 2; i * k <= n; ++k) {
                a[i * k] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return a;
}

long long sum(int a) {
    long long su = 0;
    while (a > 0) {
        su += (long long)a % 10;
        a /= 10;
    }
    return su;
}

bool prime(int n) {
    if (n == 1) return true;
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(n); ++i) {
        if (n % i == 0) return false;
    }

}

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);

vector<int> gd(int a, int b) {
    int m = (int)gcd(a, b);
    vector<int> q;
    for (int i = 1; i * i <= m; ++i) {
        if (m % i == 0) {
            q.push_back(i);
            if (i != m / i) {
                q.push_back(m / i);
            }
        }
    }
    return q;
}

int divisors(int n, int m) {
    if (n - (m + m * m) >= 0) return m;
    for (int i = (int)sqrt(m); i >= 1; --i) {
        if (m % i == 0 && n - (m + m * i) >= 0) return i;
    }
    return 1;
}

bool cal(int val, int k, int t) {
    long long res = val;
    int p = 1;
    while (val / pow(k, p) > 0) {
        res += val / pow(k, p);
        p++;
    }
    return res >= t;
}

int Last_Ocuu(int a[], int n, long long v) {
    int start = 0, end = n - 1, mid, ans = -1;
    while (start <= end) {
        mid = (start + end) >> 1;
        if (a[mid] >= v) {
            ans = mid;
            end = mid - 1;
        } else if (a[mid] < v) {
            start = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

bool Last_Ocuu(long long a[], int n, long long v) {
    int sta = 1, end = n - 1;
    while (sta <= end) {
        int mid = (sta + end) >> 1;
        if (a[mid] == v) return true;
        else if (a[mid] > v) end = mid - 1;
        else sta = mid + 1;
    }
    return false;
}

class Scannerr {
private:
    istringstream iss;
    string line;
public:
    Scannerr() {}
    void init() { getline(cin, line); iss.str(line); }
    string next() {
        while (iss.eof()) {
            getline(cin, line);
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        string token;
        iss >> token;
        return token;
    }
    double nextDouble() {
        string x = next();
        string sb = "0";
        double res = 0, f = 1;
        bool dec = false, neg = false;
        int start = 0;
        if (x[0] == '-') {
            neg = true;
            start++;
        }
        for (int i = start; i < x.size(); ++i) {
            if (x[i] == '.') {
                res = stoll(sb);
                sb = "0";
                dec = true;
            } else {
                sb += x[i];
                if (dec) f *= 10;
            }
        }
        res += stoll(sb) / f;
        return res * (neg ? -1 : 1);
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    string nextLine() {
        getline(cin, line);
        return line;
    }
    bool ready() {
        return cin.good();
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    Scannerr in;
    in.init(); // initial read
    int n = in.nextInt(), B = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) a[i] = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> sol;
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) ++even;
        else ++odd;
        if (even == odd) {
            sol.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    sort(sol.begin(), sol.end());
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)sol.size(); ++i) {
        if (sol[i] <= B) {
            ++ans;
            B -= sol[i];
        } else break;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
